name: Clips Kitty editor suite

plain_pipeline.guarantee: The same argv and files for the same inputs, and bit-exact output on the same machine with the CPU encoder. NVENC output can't be bit-exact across driver versions.
guards: Golden renders of a CC0 10-second fixture with the CPU encoder and CPU tracking
Import guard: core/pipeline.py never imports video_editor.project
plain_pipeline.max_regression: The plain pipeline must not regress by more than 10% in render time, RAM or VRAM against the baseline

rules.click_through: Colin's click-through is the final gate for every user-visible step; the Promo producer runs only after it
rules.one_at_a_time: Agents run one after another, because they share the engine port 8765, the GPU and the clock. Colin's own Clips Kitty must be closed during check runs. Performance always runs alone.
rules.honest_reporting: A builder never signs off its own work. Results are reported as measured, such as "verified the API, not the clicks".
rules.landing: Each step becomes one PR, merged when Colin says so after his click-through and once that PR's CI is green
rules.packaging: Packaged builds happen only on Colin's go
rules.strings: New UI strings go through t(), with English as the fallback; translation is a separate pass, on Colin's word
done_means: It builds, the tests pass, the black-box run passes and the output is verified
The plain pipeline is unchanged and the budgets are met
USER-GUIDE.md and CHANGELOG are updated, and licences are recorded (NOTICE, manifests)
The packaged-app check counts only at the Phase 2 milestone

steps.title: Voice service (Voicebox)
steps.scope: Voice service with Voicebox. Starts with a 1-day spike: run its pinned CPU server headless from inside our package. The server isn't published on its own, so it's taken from the pinned release installer, SHA-256-checked, into vendor/voicebox/. Clips Kitty starts and stops it like Ollama, on loopback, with --parent-pid and its own data dir. Our PyTorch is untouched. POST /voice/speak returns a WAV plus word times (a Whisper alignment if Voicebox gives none). Voices: Kokoro af_heart by default, plus Qwen3-TTS and Chatterbox. Non-commercial models are hidden. A Settings → Voice card. From here on, the promo agent uses this.
acceptance: Speaks with no GPU and no AI
Same text gives the same WAV on CPU
Word times within ±80 ms of a Whisper check
The server exits when the app closes
The core environment is unchanged (torch/CUDA check)
notes: No issue: it serves the promo videos and step V2
The Store build is CPU-only; Voicebox's GPU add-on is skipped
Voicebox becomes a 4th background process, which goes into the Store submission notes; the listing discloses the AI voice (Store policy 11.16)
